run_lr_batch_size_grid_search: run a grid search over learning rates and batch sizes for the clip_conv model on audio datasets
run_clip_explorer_with_slurm: run the ClipExplorer launcher with slurm GPU allocation on the learnlab partition
run_hyperparameter_sweep_for_clip: run a hyperparameter sweep varying lr from 1e-4 to 1e-3 and batch sizes from 32 to 256
run_offset_meg_ms_experiment: run experiments with varying MEG task offsets from 0 to 300 milliseconds
run_autoreject_comparison_experiment: run a comparison experiment with autoreject enabled and max normalization scale set to 1e12
